title: Constitution of Benches by State Commission

content.scenario: The President of the State Commission needs to constitute a Bench to hear a case, and is considering the composition of the Bench.
content.outcome: The President must constitute a Bench with one or more members, as the President may deem fit, as per CPA2019-CH4-S47-2. The senior-most member shall preside over the Bench.

user_queries: How are Benches constituted in the State Commission?
Can the President constitute a Bench with any number of members?
